name: @w6w-apps/mattermost
description: Post, edit, search and thread messages in Mattermost channels, and manage channels and their members — on Mattermost Cloud and self-hosted servers alike. Trigger workflows on new records.

w6w.longDescription:
Mattermost is a team messaging platform, self-hosted or on Mattermost Cloud, and this app posts and reads on it the way a person would: create, edit, delete and thread posts, search across them, and create channels and manage their membership.

Because a Mattermost install can be anyone's own server, this app connects to whichever instance a workflow's credentials point at rather than a single fixed host, and works the same way against a self-hosted deployment or Mattermost Cloud. Editing a post applies only the fields actually sent, so a workflow correcting one line of a message doesn't blank out its attachments or other properties. Replying to a thread always resolves to the thread's root, since Mattermost doesn't support nested threads.

This app covers day-to-day messaging — posting, editing, searching, and managing channels and their members — rather than user or team administration, incoming/outgoing webhook configuration, or reactions and file attachments, which stay out of scope for this first pass.

Poll triggers start workflows when a new post appears.
